'''S-9B9''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|shopkeeper droid]] stationed inside the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] base on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]].
